name: Jii ~Nozoki no Houshuu~
source:
Junya Akechi is a student who tutors girls preparing for entrance exams. He invites five such girls to study at his uncle's cottage for a week. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
明智純也是一個輔導女生準備考試的學生。他邀請了五名這樣的女生到叔叔的小屋學習一週。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
